AT 1515 HOURS LOCAL TIME ON MONDAY, MAY 29, THE LOCAL
SWITCHBOARD OPERATOR AT THE IRAN AMERICA SOCIETY ACADEMIC
CENTER IN TEHRAN RECEIVED A BOMB THREAT FROM AN
UNIDENTIFIED IRANIAN MALE WHO STATED IN FARSI: "THERE IS
A BOMB IN THE BUILDING WHICH WILL EXPLODE IN TEN MINUTES."
CALL WAS TERMINATED AFTER PASSING THIS MESSAGE. BUILDING,
WHICH WAS FULL OF STUDENTS, WAS QUICKLY EVACUATED. POLICE
WERE SUMMONED AND ARRIVED ALMOST IMMEDIATELY. SUBSEQUENT
SEARCH PROVED NEGATIVE.
SULLIVAN
